newsitem.title: UK: British wool sale sees good competition.
newsitem.headline: British wool sale sees good competition.

text.p: The first British wool sales of the new season was held at Bradford and attracted good competition which cleared 90 percent of the offering according to the British Wool Marketing Board (BWMB).
The Committee of London Wool Brokers acting on behalf of the BWMB offered approximately 2,179,221 kilos.

Compared with the last Bradford sale on June 4 the trends at the sale saw Picks and Supers, Mashams and Radnors unchanged, Halfbreds and crosses (except Best wrs) moved in sellers favour, Best wrs were two percent dearer, Welsh 2.5 percent dearer .
Northern Ireland Descriptions sold strongly with Halfbreds five percent dearer.
